title: UW Markdown Distribution Waterfall Section
description: Content payload for the `distribution_waterfall` section (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4.27, RFC 0035). The tiered LP/GP split of a deal's equity cash flows — return of capital, preferred return, GP catch-up, and promote splits — over a referenced `cash_flow_series` variant (§4.26). The fourth state-and-verify structure (RFC 0021 §6): `verifyWaterfall` recomputes the ENTIRE allocation by the normative Protocol §VIII.10 walk, never trusting the stated splits. This schema enforces structure only. The cross-field rules a validator/verifier adds: the ladder grammar incl. ordering, singleton, terminal-uncapped-split, sum-to-one, and gp_share>target_promote rules (WF-01); the cash reference resolving in-document (WF-02); at least one contribution in the referenced series (WF-03); and every stated outcome/schedule cell recomputing at its quantization boundary or the verdict is `failed`.

_meta.description: Standard block provenance envelope (§2.5). Not constrained here.

cash_flow_ref.description: The §4.26 cash_flow_series variant holding the EQUITY cash vector: negative amounts are contributions, positive amounts are distributable cash. Its day_count governs every year fraction here.

equity_split.description: Each party's share of every contribution; must sum to 1.0 (ratio quantum, WF-01). The GP share is co-invest; the promote comes from the tiers.

tiers.description: The ordered ladder: return_of_capital? → preferred_return? → catch_up? → split+ with an uncapped final split (WF-01).

stated_outcomes.description: Headline claims, each verified when present (quanta: $→2, x→4, %→6).

promote_total.description: GP distributions above its returned capital + pref receipts.

stated_schedule.description: Optional per-date distribution detail, one entry per distribution date; checked cell-for-cell against the recomputed allocation, with absent cells reading 0. Display detail — the verifier recomputes regardless.

xirr.description: Fraction, recomputed by the §VIII.9.3 procedure over the party's dated flows.

target_promote.description: gp_share MUST exceed this (WF-01) or the tier can never fill.

until_lp_em.description: Equity-multiple hurdle capping the tier; the final split must be uncapped, and a capped split must have lp_share > 0 (WF-01). `until_lp_irr` is reserved and refused until a future RFC.
